{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Print the number of loyal customers to verify the count
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {len(loyal_customers)}")

# Compute the fraction who converted (converted == 1)
converted_fraction = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Print the converted fraction
print(f"Fraction of loyal customers who converted: {converted_fraction}")

# Round to 4 decimal places for reporting
converted_fraction_rounded = round(converted_fraction, 4)
print(f"Rounded fraction: {converted_fraction_rounded}")"}
